Name: Evi
Summary: Evi was one of the five kings of Midian slain by Israel in the war that followed the idolatry at Peor.
KeyStory: Evi fell to Israel's sword when Moses sent a thousand men of every tribe against Midian.
RelatedPeople: Rekem; Zur; Hur, King of Midian; Reba; Moses; Phinehas
LifeLesson: The gods of Midian could not protect their own kings.
